values.RouteNotes: No published route or GIS found; only that it runs through Pogarsky and Starodubsky districts of Bryansk Oblast to GRS Starodub. Start tie-in not stated in sources. Not mapped.

researcher_notes: Confirmed by 2 loading Russian sources that name the pipeline (second string of the gas-pipeline branch to GRS Starodub): Interfax 2026-09 (Gazprom transgaz Moskva 2025 results / 2030 plans) and AiF Bryansk 2025-08-22 (oblast government press service). Both state completed construction, >46 km, 13 valve sites, 6 road/rail crossings and 4 water crossings in Pogarsky and Starodubsky districts. Likely a common upstream (Gazprom transgaz Moskva / oblast govt release), so independent=false, tier medium. Not on roster: Bryansk rows are only P2288 (Bryansk-Smolensk), P2387 (Shebelinka-Belgorod-Kursk-Bryansk) and P1465 (Dashava-Kiev-Bryansk-Moscow); none is a Starodub branch. Passes threshold: sponsor Gazprom (operator Gazprom transgaz Moskva, subsidiary; entity_lookup fuzzy-hit 'Transgaz' not equal, owner recorded as Gazprom PJSC [100%] per existing entity), endpoints region + GRS Starodub, built (completed 2025). Length >=25 km: LengthKnown 46 km is the stated floor ('>46 km'; a separate search snippet of interfax-russia.ru, bot-walled and unverifiable here so not cited, says 44 km of DN500 welded in the first six months from Jul 2024, construction began Jul 2024). Diameter DN500 (500 mm) is therefore left BLANK for want of a verifiable ref; fill if interfax-russia.ru item 'Gazprom podklyuchil gazoprovod v Bryanskoy oblasti...' can be fetched. Status operating inferred from 'completed'/'connected'; commissioning date not stated; StartYear not filled. First string exists but is not on roster and no data found on it. Stage 2, GRS Starodub - GRS Novozybkov connector (gazoprovod-peremychka), in design/MTR procurement per Interfax, planned 2025-2026 per AiF, length not given: stays monitor-level (length), not staged. PipelineType transmission is a judgement (Gazprom trunk-subsidiary DN500 feeder to GRS). StartLocation blank: tie-in point not found.
